text:
maria.g: quick RFC follow-up. i sketched an observability/event schema to track quant artifacts (fp8/int8/4bit) so console + oncall can triage quality regressions. pls sanity-check before i open the PR.

samir: good start. big question: tie to profile only or to model+profile+route?

maria.g: model+profile+route. we want to correlate per-customer regressions and prompt anchors.

aj: include a compact example payload and a console query so SRE can wire alerts.

maria.g: example payload (redacted): artifact_event: model=redwood-v2-medium; profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-03; profile_version=3; route=/chat/generate; event_id=evt-20260301-01; bucket=high; fidelity_budget=0.12; degrade_score=0.87; quality_anchor=qa_set_v1; anchor_examples=[weather_short, task_extract_long]; token_index=23; residual_norm=0.042; kv_mismatch=false; sample_output_snippet="[redacted] less specific about dates"; redaction_flag=true; metadata_ttl_seconds=1209600; sample_ttl_seconds=604800; explainability_collected=false; explainability_uri="gs://..."; collect_cost_ms=0.5; collect_size_bytes=20480

li: nit: use snake_case everywhere; add severity bucket for dashboarding; attach customer_tier and canary_flag tags.

maria.g: noted. console should show a small diff vs anchor when available and provide link to explainability artifact (admin-only).

ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 24h --profile fp8-aggressive --group-by route,model

jenna: suggested metrics: quant.artifact.count, quant.degrade.p50, quant.degrade.p95, quant.anchor.regressions, quant.residual_norm.avg. export prometheus-friendly labels too.

samir: heavy question: do we ever collect token-level explainability? helpful but costly.

maria.g: gated opt-in for canaries/customers. default explainability_collected=false. when true we emit explainability_uri and metadata about cost/size; retrieval requires admin scope.

aj: ops reminder: redact PII in sample_output_snippet; add a mandatory redaction step and two-tier TTLs as shown above.

li: add an artifact_resolution event with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback, profile_tweak, false_positive, noop} and resolver_name+notes so product/comms can close the loop.

maria.g: will add artifact_resolution, a short backfill script to tag historical artifacts by profile_version, and a tiny logger shim that emits the payload to telemetry.

jenna: also please include estimated costs in doc: collecting explainability is ~0.5ms p99 and ~20kb per collected artifact so product can decide default.

aj: one more ops ask: include a compact json example and a sample alert rule: WHEN quant.degrade.p95 > 0.75 for 10m THEN page oncall with top anchor_examples and diffs; AUTOMATIC_ACTION: add profile to shadow-sampling for 1h.

maria.g: thanks all. i'll open PR with schema (snake_case), console mockups, backend shim, runbook (redaction, TTLs, admin access), and microbench numbers. tagging reviewers. :pray:

ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, aj, li, jenna in #eng-ml
